text:
maria_cs: Heads-up — LumaTech onboarding asked for a copy of our SOC2 and temporary access to their telemetry for verification. They want to finish compliance review by EOW. Any objections to the ask?
jon_security: We can provide the SOC2 attestation and a short, redacted evidence package. We should not provide raw telemetry or logs. Can you confirm exactly which datasets they want to see?
rachel_legal: Agreed with Jon. Also recommend we offer a DPA + an access plan: scoped, time-limited, read-only, and logged. We can preapprove a one-week window if infra signs off.
maria_cs: They asked for "user-event stream" and a handful of recent API request traces to confirm retention and masking. Wants it in next 3 business days.
jon_security: Request traces are sensitive. Two options: (1) provide sanitized/aggregated traces with PII removed, (2) create a scripted demo that reproduces relevant events using synthetic data. Which do they prefer?
sam_infra: From infra side we can spin up ephemeral, read-only access via a temporary role that only returns metadata and hashed identifiers. Or we can run an export job that redacts fields and drops payloads. Both are doable; export job ETA ~48h once scope confirmed.
kevin_pm: Also propose a 30-min walkthrough with LumaTech to show controls instead of raw data. Often faster and avoids long security review. I can host Thurs morning.
maria_cs: Good call. I'll ask them if a walkthrough + redacted export is acceptable. If they insist on traces, we'll do export job + signed URL.
rachel_legal: For the DPA side, we need their legal contact and the specific processing activities. I'll prepare a DPA addendum template and flag the one-week access window.
jon_security: Action items: (a) Maria confirm scope w/ LumaTech today; (b) Sam estimate exact export fields & redact rules by EOD; (c) Rachel prepare DPA addendum draft; (d) Kevin schedule walkthrough slot. If anyone can't hit EOD, call it out.
maria_cs: I'll ping them now. @kevin_pm can you tentatively reserve Thurs 9am PT?
kevin_pm: Reserved. If they want different time we can shift.
sam_infra: I'll draft the export command and list of redacted fields here once I finish triage. Expect a snippet like:
```bash
redact-export --source traces --drop-pii --hash-ids --since 2026-03-01 --out redacted-traces.tar.gz
```
jon_security: Nice. When you post the snippet, I'll sanity-check for accidental leakage and add audit requirements.
maria_cs: Thanks team. I'll post their reply here.
deploy-bot: Note: security-prod deploy scheduled at 2026-03-12T22:00Z — no infra changes that would affect exports. :white_check_mark:
